population.data_hash_verification: All input identities below are checked before computation.

gap_record.role: Frozen predecessor confirmatory record only; no new fit, scoring, bootstrap, selection or reading.

inputs.primary: initial structures; frozen mean-pooled scalar-node features
inputs.energy_convention: MP2020 once on initial structure via pymatgen 2023.5.10; CHGNet no second correction, exclusively _nomp2020.
inputs.hull: Fixed MP composition hull, never rebuilt from WBM labels or fitted-arm energies.
inputs.feature_hash_override_authority: The accepted regenerated feature arrays failed two equivalence-check points, including the retained numerical-equivalence check. The explicit feature_inputs hashes define the accepted inputs; legacy registry hashes differ. No silent replacement or bypass of these checks is allowed.

backbones.orb_caveat: Non-invariant descriptor and broader pretraining; the predecessor exploratory role does not limit its inclusion in the new five-checkpoint families.
backbones.checkpoint_bytes: The five checkpoint hashes are explicit and correspond to the feature/reference inputs; the MatterSim checkpoint is the 5M version.

P.draw: Canonical lexicographic material_id outer-training order; default_rng(draw_fold_multiplier*f+r+draw_seed_offset).choice(train_size,size=n,replace=False). Identical draws shared by all arms; budgets use the same seed formula, not enforced nested subsets.
P.budget_unit: n labels per outer-fold learner, not n labels total over all folds or replicates.

S.role: secondary, separate readings for S-a and S-b
S.draw: campaign campaign_draw: sort pool IDs; sort unique systems; default_rng(sampler_seed_offset+sampler_budget_multiplier*n+r).permutation(systems); concatenate canonical IDs within whole systems until reaching n, truncate final system to exact n. Not uniform structure sampling.
S.fit_reuse: One fit and draw scores the full S-a test set; S-b is its fixed subset. Same training pool and model choices. No new tuning on either test set.

replicates.missing_or_partial: No reading from partial folds or a reduced replicate set; report incomplete, no substitution by PILOT.

budgets.FT_scope: F4 budgets 1000 and 3000, all five draws; descriptive P n10000 draw 0 only.

inner.rule: v1.2 inner_split: sorted distinct draw chemical systems, default_rng(P.draw_fold_multiplier*f+r+seed_offset) permutation; take complete systems until cumulative count first reaches fraction*n. S uses f=S.inner_fold_index. Validation can exceed the fraction.
inner.selection: Highest inner-validation AP for each learner separately; first grid point wins exact ties; refit on all n drawn labels. No outer labels in selection, standardization or prior estimation.
inner.single_class: Exact arms binary_select fallback: if inner fit or validation is single-class, first grid for each type without grid evaluation; inner diagnostic equals validation prevalence. If full draw single-class, constant class score; else refit first grid on full draw. No redraw. C1 always tunes by AP and first-grid ties, including all-zero validation AP. Empty inner split is a hard error.
inner.empty_split: STOP; amendment required before retry, no redraw
inner.scope: Shared draw-system split. AP grid selection applies only to inner-selected CPU arms; A5f has no selection; FT uses strict validation per-atom MSE with epoch zero selectable.

hist_gbm.grid_order: learning_rate outer loop, max_leaf_nodes inner loop; other defaults pinned to sklearn version

logistic_descriptive.scale: StandardScaler fitted on phase-training rows only; lbfgs

arms.notation: F_k=frozen initial features; c=raw element fractions; hhat_k=stored zero-shot signed hull distance; f_DFT=corrected formation label; h_MP=e_form_pred_sp-hhat_k.

R0_star.definition: max_k AP(R0_k) on the same evaluation population; deterministic references have identical replicate metrics; recompute the maximum for every bootstrap draw, never freeze the observed winner
R0_star.name: the strongest measured zero-shot comparator
R0_star.interpretation: Evaluation-label oracle over five fixed references; not a deployable selection rule. Matched-checkpoint F3/F4 are separate.

E0.disambiguation: E0 ensemble arm differs from elemental atomic E0 offsets in FT; neither median nor probability averaging is the named ensemble.

C1.hull: fixed; retain fold intercepts when pooling
C1.prose_name: RR; distinct from predecessor C1 membership association

A4.selection: HistGBM only for confirmatory contrasts; logistic and best menu outputs are descriptive; composition is present in the code tree variant.

A1.role: DESCRIPTIVE in every cell, no readings

FT.epoch0: foundation checkpoint; selectable; E0 frozen and excluded from AdamW
FT.scoring: INITIAL geometry, MP2020 once, rounded elemental references, fixed MP hull derived from pinned reference predictions; no test labels in training or energy conversion
FT.selection: strict inner-validation per-atom MSE improvement including epoch 0; fresh foundation refit on all draw IDs for exactly selected epochs
FT.target: raw relaxed CSE DFT total energy; only drawn training IDs through verified freeze guard

arms.other_cells: Any emitted cell outside the exact family definitions is descriptive, including A2/A3, A4 logistic/best and E0 median; no added run is authorized just by this catch-all.

A5f.selection: none; one fit on all n draw labels

metrics.P: For each r, pool scores of its held-out outer-fold pipelines over the full CONFIRM population; M_r=AP(y,s_r); M=mean_r(M_r). Never mean fold AP or replicate scores.
metrics.S: For each r, AP on the fixed variant test population; M=mean_r(M_r). No outer-fold averaging or synthetic five-fold pooling in S.
metrics.report: Every AP has structure count, positive count and prevalence; retain scores, IDs, replicate, fold, draw, inner split, selected parameters and flags.
metrics.precision: Descriptive; ceil(top_fraction*N) for every new analysis. P learners: per fold then pooled hits/selected; S: per variant test set; mechanism: per reporting population. Score-descending/material_id-ascending ties.
metrics.missing: Nonfinite labels hard error as predecessor. arms requires complete finite five-reference and feature coverage; do not drop or impute silently. Broader predecessor intersection sensitivities are not the primary v2 population.
metrics.half_round_role: Legacy inactive provenance only; no new analysis uses it.
metrics.label_finiteness: Check all requested labels at run start, after verified freeze; STOP on any nonfinite value, no fallback/intersection.

inference.bootstrap: Paired chemical-system cluster, conditional on fitted models. Sort evaluation systems; fresh default_rng(seed) per design; draw as many systems with replacement as present; carry all structures and every arm/replicate score with cluster multiplicities. P resamples all CONFIRM systems; S resamples test systems only; no refitting or resampling training labels.
inference.recompute: Recompute all weighted M_r then M, oracle R0_star (for reporting) and F2 contender maximum after replicate aggregation. F1 up component tests and F1/F2 down fixed-ORB tests never subtract a resampled reference maximum.
inference.interval: Unadjusted two-sided nominal percentile summary; numpy.percentile linear; interval does not determine reading.
inference.percentile_band_qualification: Oracle and contender-maximum percentile bands are descriptive, nominal percentile summaries; their coverage can be poor at ties and they must not be presented as calibrated 90 % confidence intervals.
inference.multiplicity: Separate directional Holm families within each family AND design. No pooling across directions, designs or families; no global familywise error claim. Holm ties by contrast name.

readings.ADDS: F1: Holm-adjusted max_k p_up,k <= alpha; F3/F4: ordinary matched-reference Holm up. F2 up is descriptive only.
readings.DOES_NOT_EXCEED: down Holm-adjusted p <= alpha: increment below +m, not zero benefit

inference.invalid: Nonfinite bootstrap contrasts stop readings. Undefined descriptive AUROC draws are omitted with counts; this omission rule is new in v2.3, not inherited from v1.2.
inference.fixed_reference_selection: ORB v3, best PILOT design-P reference; fixed before CONFIRM; never reselected per design or bootstrap.
inference.F1_up: IUT: p_IUT=max_k p_up(M(arm)-M(R0_k)); apply family Holm to these per-contrast p-values.
inference.F1_F2_down: Test against fixed R0_orb, a sufficient condition for the strongest measured zero-shot comparator; F2 keeps the contender maximum.
inference.F2_up: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY; no confirmatory ADDS reading from the contender maximum.
inference.down_reporting: Every DOES_NOT_EXCEED reading is reported with its down_estimate and down_interval against fixed ORB; the oracle estimate is labelled descriptive.
inference.calibration_regression_scope: The original family rates used identical contrasts. When the other contrasts are clearly rejected, the family error equals the scalar tail: approximately 0.056 at N = 1,000 and approximately 0.051 at N = 59,319 in the binary construction. The gate checks reproduced fixture values +/- Monte Carlo tolerance as a regression check; it does not assert family-level error control.
inference.draw_spread: Report sample SD (ddof=1) of M_r next to every reading, with reference SD and contrast-draw SD; fixed point-estimate winners for maxima. Training draw/refit variability is not included in cluster intervals.

margin.rationale_v1_2: below about 2 points of average precision a practitioner would not change pipelines given the cost of 3,000 DFT labels
margin.scope: Common fixed 0.02 AP at every tested budget; no budget-specific tuning or continuous-threshold claim.

rationale_by_budget.n300: A minimal label purchase warrants a gain large enough to change the screening pipeline; the same practical AP floor avoids treating tiny cheap-budget shifts as useful.
rationale_by_budget.n1000: An intermediate label purchase still requires the same pipeline-changing AP gain, rather than a smaller significance-driven threshold.
rationale_by_budget.n3000: This is the historical reference cost underlying the practical AP floor; it is reported separately and cannot rescue success.
rationale_by_budget.n10000: The largest label investment must clear at least the same practical AP floor; the high-budget F1 test is the informative part of the success conjunction.

margin.information: Low-budget DOES_NOT_EXCEED was expected from PILOT for related controls; it is weak additional evidence. A5f itself was never run at n<=1000 on PILOT, so this expectation does not guarantee success. F1 at 10000 is the informative test.

F1.contrasts: M(A5f_k)-M(R0_star) for every backbone, plus M(A4 hist_gbm)-M(R0_star)
F1.role: confirmatory, exposure-informed; descriptive if any C05 A5f source FAIL or missing
F1.up_test: IUT max component p, followed by six-contrast family Holm
F1.down_test: fixed R0_orb sufficient condition, followed by six-contrast family Holm

F2.bootstrap: Maximum of contender replicate-mean APs, minus fixed R0_orb for down tests. Report oracle difference separately; oracle-maximum up tails are descriptive only.
F2.role: confirmatory, exposure-informed; descriptive if any C05 A5f source FAIL or missing

F3.role: negative control; down is below positive practical margin, not proof of equality or harm

F4.status: ACTIVE; P primary, S-a/S-b secondary; separate directional Holm over all four contrasts in each design; outside success rule

success.high_reading: ADDS for at least one A5f contrast
success.otherwise: Report as observed; no outcome-dependent change to the specified scope.
success.not_required: F2 at its remaining budget, F3, F4 and secondary designs do not change this rule.
success.completion: Judge as soon as all design-P F1 and F2 contrasts are complete; F3/F4/S/mechanism may be incomplete or fail.

probe.design: P only; same outer folds, all outer-training CONFIRM labels (not an n-label correction learner); no replicate dimension
probe.ridge: Train-only StandardScaler and intercept; leave each other outer-training fold out for inner CV; choose each target alpha by pooled inner MAE, first alpha on exact ties; refit all outer-training rows.
probe.strata: Correction flags true/false and disjoint joint strata; element count; cumulative inclusive absolute-y boundary windows. Report sizes, prevalence, within-stratum flip rates and shares of all flips.
probe.caveat: Finite decoder performance is not proof of irreversible feature information loss; full-range R2 does not establish precision at the hull. No causal MP2020 claim.

descriptive.cells: Every remaining arm x budget x design cell; all A1; descriptive budget; AUROC; top-fraction precision; per-round test results; mechanism; numerical noise.; every inner-selected A5; FT at n=10000 P draw 0 only, no F4 reading
descriptive.per_round: In S, re-evaluate retained replicate scores separately within each specified test round and variant; no additional fitting or winner selection.
descriptive.intervals: Same conditional cluster-bootstrap settings for descriptive AP/AUROC contrasts; no Holm and no readings. Precision, strata and numerical-noise diagnostics follow pinned source reporting; interval convention beyond source output requires specification before affected analysis.
descriptive.band_gap: Frozen predecessor confirmatory result carried over as a labelled historical record; no new analysis in this protocol.
descriptive.A2_A3_record: PILOT negative; cite CONFIRM delta record descriptively, no rerun.
descriptive.interval_comparators: Point/interval per retained method; checkpoint-specific methods versus their own R0; ensemble methods versus each fixed R0, labelled descriptive. AP/AUROC use paired draws; undefined AUROC counts reported. No readings.

noise.definition: arms noise_unit: keep selected params fixed; max absolute inner AP change under seeded relative Gaussian input perturbations. Encoder inputs in original float32 for feature arms; fractions for C1/A3; learner inputs for A4; scoring/target reference values held fixed, perturbed fractions not renormalized. Local diagnostic, not an uncertainty bound.
noise.pre_freeze_issue: Apply the fixed PILOT stability criterion below before interpreting the comparisons. A failing or missing source makes all F1/F2 readings descriptive; no grid or input change.
noise.confirm_scope: Apply the specified local diagnostic to new CPU arms using P and campaign inner units, descriptive only; no gate tuning on CONFIRM.

pre_freeze_check.perturb: Encoder features and hull distances only; composition fractions unchanged; refit whole selected pooled out-of-fold pipeline for each noise seed.
pre_freeze_check.failure: Any FAIL A5f source makes all F1/F2 readings descriptive; no silent source deletion or family resize. Missing source evidence likewise blocks confirmation.

named_cpu.role: C14: n=100 P only; only exact family cells receive readings; all A1 and A4 logistic/best descriptive. add A5f, demote all inner-selected A5.

run_matrix.computed_comparator: R0_star from reference AP; not a score vector
run_matrix.additional_source_outputs: Retain emitted A4 logistic/best and P E0 median as descriptive. A2/A3 and other historical controls are not scheduled by this card; if retained or later authorized, always descriptive.

ft_recipe.loop: Strict inner-validation per-atom MSE improvement; frozen foundation E0; fresh checkpoint per phase; exactly selected epochs on all draw IDs; no scheduler/replay; float32-highest

execution.C05_resolution: All five fixed A5f sources PASS the specified PILOT numerical-stability criterion. A failed or missing source makes all F1/F2 readings descriptive, retaining the complete family and source set.
execution.optional_CPU_P_failures: Failed or unavailable F3/ancillary CPU-P units are logged explicitly, without partial F3 readings; complete F1/F2 still determine success. Required F1/F2 unit or population failures stop their judgment. No specification, input or family size changes.
execution.stage_chain: Each completed stage binds earlier stage manifests and all output hashes locally. The mechanism stage may use terminal INCOMPLETE_CAP fine-tuning stages; missing F4 cells receive no reading.
